export async function recordView(supabase: any, userId: string) {
  // Cast: the RPC is newer than the last types regeneration.
  void (supabase.rpc as any)("record_profile_view", { p_viewed_user_id: userId });
}

export async function eligibility(supabase: any) {
  // Cast: the RPC is newer than the last types regeneration.
  const { data } = await (supabase.rpc as never as (
    fn: string,
    args: Record<string, unknown>,
  ) => Promise<{ data: unknown }>)(
    "subscription_purchase_eligibility",
    { p_platform: "apple" },
  );
  return data;
}
